title: 第19章 营中秘境第20章 灵气之说
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
大魏军制分的很细，并非领兵者皆是将官。
伍长、什长、队正、都伯、曲督、军司马、都尉、校尉，军中八职为治军框架。
都伯以下为卒编入军户，都伯以上为官入官籍，校尉以上为将事奏朝堂。
可以说只有成了校尉，才算融入了大魏的统治阶层，否则皆是奉命而动的部曲。
但这不代表都尉等级的职位不贵，至少在军中，都尉掌握着一营的生杀大权。
周元没想到，射声营的李都尉会亲自见他，以至于武威营中的士卒都以为他是隐藏的世家子。
“且试试这把弓，箭支随便射，让我看看你的耐力。”
“诺。”
砰砰砰，一声声重击的声音在校场回荡。
周元的射术虽然不合格，但还不至于乱箭飞舞，至少能保证箭矢落到同一片区域。
当三十支箭射完后，以他的身躯强度都有些劳累，臂膀也出现了酸胀火灼的痛感。
“好，当真是天生的神臂手，你今日开弓青涩暴力，加以培养便不会如此费力了。
我惜你之才，欲调你入射声营、任什长之职，他日若能演武显威，必为你谋一官身。”
“多谢都尉爱护，元感激不尽。”
“莫慌着谢，射声营与武威营不同，武威贵、射声平。
武威营是整个靖安军最精华所在，其卒敢战能射，多由世家子统兵。
射声营的待遇与武卫营有些差距，但升职更容易，其中得失需你自行思虑。”
“何思之有，都尉既许军职、官身，我愿入射声营效力。”
对周元来说呆在武卫营确实不错，可入了射声营能和统营都尉说上话，这无疑是身份地位的巨大提升。
有了领导赏识，再加上属性面板的技能加持，他将获得一条稳定的晋升通道。

“好，随我走吧，我为你换一位教头。”
武卫营在城东、射声营在城西，李都尉虽然说射声营与武威营有差距，但那明显指的是士卒待遇，而非军官待遇。
在新军营周元不仅获得了更大的房间、更有营养的吃食，还跳过了选拔阶段，直接获得了正式兵牌与盔甲。
射声营的盔甲是灵活性相对高的环臂甲，而非武卫营常用的铁札甲。
防御力方面铁札甲比较全面、也更沉重，环臂甲重手臂伸展、也轻便一些。
领了盔甲后，周元便开始接受系统性的训练了，在一位善射之士的教导下，他很快获得了新的技能。
【你领悟了‘控弦’，掌握了一种射术】
【控弦，lv1（110）】
【效果：气力合一，凝神锁敌，增幅身躯协调、强化精神专注】
由系统性教导转化而成的控弦技能，比周元自己摸索出的刺枪、力劈华山更全面，不仅有攻击效果，还附带强化效果。
有了专业的指导、充足的饮食，周元开始发疯式的练武。
食补技能帮他回血、休养技能为他缓解负面状态。
在这两个恢复性技能的保障下，射声营出现了一个让人头皮发麻的勤奋型天才。
每天天刚微微亮他便开始练弓了，等到天黑时他还在练弓，仿佛他有一幅铁臂膀，不会产生疲劳。
这种惨烈的锻炼模式，在营中教头看来简直就是自残。
他阻止了很多次，都没能改变周元的练武节奏。
content_en:
The Wei army was organized very carefully, and not all of its leaders were generals.
The eight positions in the army, including Wu Commander, Chief Commander, Dui Zheng, Du Bo, Qu Du, Army Sima, Du Wei, and Xiao Wei, form the framework for running the army.
Those below Du Bo were soldiers and were incorporated into military households, those above Du Bo were officers and were registered as officials, and those above Du Bo were generals who reported their affairs to the court.
It can be said that only by becoming a captain can one be integrated into the ruling class of the Wei Dynasty. Otherwise, it is just a matter of following orders.
But this does not mean that the position of captain is not expensive. At least in the army, the captain holds the power of life and death of a battalion.
Zhou Yuan did not expect that Lieutenant Li from the Shesheng Camp would see him in person, so much so that the soldiers in the Wuwei Camp thought he was a hidden son of an aristocratic family.
"Try this bow and shoot as many arrows as you like. Let me see your endurance."
"No."
Bang bang bang, a thumping sound echoed in the school grounds.
Although Zhou Yuan's archery skills were not up to standard, they were not enough to cause arrows to fly randomly. At least they were able to ensure that the arrows landed in the same area.
After shooting thirty arrows, his body was a little tired due to the strength of his body, and his arms also felt sore and burning.
"Okay, you are really born with a magical arm. You are young and violent today, so it won't be so laborious to cultivate it.
I cherish your talent and would like to transfer you to Sheng Sheng camp and hold you in a senior position. If you can perform martial arts and show your power in the future, I will definitely find an official position for you. "
"Thank you Captain for your love and care. I am deeply grateful."
"Don't be in a hurry to thank me. Shesheng Camp is different from Wuwei Camp. Wuwei is noble but Shesheng is flat.
Wuwei Camp is the most elite place of the entire Jing'an Army. Its soldiers are brave enough to fight and can shoot, and most of them are led by sons of aristocratic families.
The treatment in the Shesheng camp is somewhat different from that in the Wuwei camp, but it is easier to get promoted. You need to think about the pros and cons by yourself. "
"What do you think? Since the captain has promised me a military position and an official status, I am willing to join the Shengsheng camp and serve."
For Zhou Yuan, staying in the Wuwei Camp was indeed a good thing, but entering the Shesheng Camp and being able to talk to the Tongying Captain was undoubtedly a huge improvement in status.
With the leadership's appreciation and the skill blessing from the attribute panel, he will have a stable promotion path.
"Okay, let me go, I will find a new coach for you."
Wuwei Camp is in the east of the city, and Shesheng Camp is in the west of the city. Although Li Duwei said that there is a difference between Shesheng Camp and Wuwei Camp, it obviously refers to the treatment of soldiers, not officers.
In the new military camp, Zhou Yuan not only received a larger room and more nutritious food, he also skipped the selection stage and directly received official military cards and armor.
The armor of the Shesheng Battalion is a relatively flexible ring armour, rather than the iron armor commonly used in the Wuwei Battalion.
In terms of defense, the iron armor is more comprehensive and heavier, while the arm armor is heavier and lighter when the arms are extended.
After receiving the armor, Zhou Yuan began to receive systematic training. Under the guidance of a good archer, he quickly acquired new skills.
[You have understood ‘string control’ and mastered a shooting technique]
[Control strings, lv1 (110)]
[Effectiveness: Unite your energy and strength, focus on the enemy, increase body coordination, and strengthen mental concentration]
The string control skills transformed from systematic teaching are more comprehensive than the stabbing spear and force splitting Huashan that Zhou Yuan discovered on his own. It not only has an attack effect, but also has a strengthening effect.
With professional guidance and adequate food, Zhou Yuan began to practice martial arts like crazy.
The food supplement skill can help him recover his blood, and the rest skill can relieve his negative status.
With the guarantee of these two restorative skills, a dizzyingly hard-working genius appeared in Shesheng Camp.
He started to practice bowing every day at dawn, and he was still practicing bowing when it got dark, as if he had an iron arm that would not cause fatigue.
This brutal training mode seemed like self-harm to the instructors in the camp.
He stopped him many times but failed to change Zhou Yuan's martial arts training rhythm.
